scope.evidence_basis: Actual original-source comparison and local derivation reread: Read and reconstructed all of source Lemma 1. If the inequality fails, [u_n]+[v_n]>0; dividing both points by that sum keeps gauges<=1. A common subsequence converges in A0. Its A1 distance tends to zero because its bounded A0 distance is divided by n, so injectivity makes the two limits equal, contradicting separation.

N-cone-ehrling: Normalize both cone points by the sum of their gauges and use compactness plus injectivity.
